title: egl wrap fix for gpu export

commit.merge_subject: merge: egl wrap fix for gpu export

description:
The Xiaomi 15 Ultra GPU export fell back honestly with
reason=surface-input-unavailable:egl-wrap: both
eglCreateWindowSurface sites (configureSurfaceVideoCodec and the
adoptEncoderSurface twin) passed surfaceAttribs =
{ EGL_RECORDABLE_ANDROID, 1, EGL_NONE }, and the device returned
EGL_NO_SURFACE for that form. The RECORDABLE flag is already required
in the CONFIG setupEgl chooses (eglChooseConfig line ~268), so the
window-surface attribs repeated it — redundant at best, fatal on this
device's EGL.

Evidence: the M4 preview session (GlesPreviewSession.cpp:753) creates
its window surface on the SAME device with nullptr attribs and works;
Grafika (the project's EGL reference) also rides the flag on the
config with a null attrib list.

Fix: pass null at BOTH call sites — the EGL14 platform-type binding
treats null as the empty/default attrib list (the native nullptr
form). The RECORDABLE fl
